reuse.why: The range handler reuses recurrence conversion and weekend adjustment, but getNextDate independently implements daily exclusion instead of using applyWeekendRule.

duplication.why: Daily non-working-day exclusion is implemented both in applyWeekendRule and in getNextDate's conditional filtering.

placement.why: Calendar policy remains in shared/schedules.ts and endpoint registration follows existing conventions, although handlers also encode policy-dependent search bounds.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the requested recurrence changes, their consumers, tests, types and release notes.

maintainability.why: Shared holiday classification is useful, but parallel daily handling, independently chosen search limits and an untyped endpoint config make future changes harder to coordinate.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts:getNextDate filters daily non-working occurrences itself and disables skipWeekend when subsequently calling applyWeekendRule.

disguised_duplication.where: getNextDate reshapes applyWeekendRule's daily null-return decision into firstWeekday filtering followed by suppression of the shared rule.

abstraction_drift.where: WeekendRule gains frequency and holidays, and getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a holidays argument; daily-specific branches appear in applyWeekendRule and getNextDate's take selection and firstWeekday filter, while getNextDate bypasses the shared daily decision.
